title: Atkore fiscal Q2 2026 results
excerpt: Atkore reported fiscal Q2 net sales of USD 731.4 million, adjusted EBITDA of USD 81.1 million, adjusted diluted EPS of USD 1.23, and maintained fiscal-2026 adjusted EBITDA guidance of USD 340-360 million and adjusted diluted EPS guidance of USD 5.05-5.55.
summary: The issuer release supports current management guidance, adjusted earnings, electrical volume growth, margin compression, cash-flow, and portfolio-simplification analysis.
